visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair and a black shirt appears in a bright studio. He has a black hair clip on his forehead. The frame is split by a vertical line, showing a 'with makeup' side and a 'without makeup' side. He points to his face and smiles. (2) He stands in a room with a grey textured wall and a small lamp. He holds two skincare products from the brand OBgE, gesturing towards them while looking directly at the camera. (3) The scene shifts to an outdoor setting with a blue sky and green trees. The man wears a light beige shirt and sunglasses while talking on a pink smartphone. He shows the phone screen and his glasses to the camera, highlighting makeup smudges. (4) Back in the studio, he holds a translucent spray bottle and sprays it towards his face, closing his eyes. (5) He holds the OBgE foundation stick close to the camera, showing its core-shell structure. An inset image of a smiling woman appears briefly. (6) A fast-motion sequence shows him applying the foundation stick to his cheeks and forehead. (7) He presents a 'Before' and 'After' comparison of his face with a sparkling filter effect. (8) He wipes his face with a white tissue and shows the clean tissue to the camera to demonstrate the smudge-proof quality of the product.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a promotional tutorial aimed at men, showcasing OBgE cosmetic products. It utilizes a before-and-after comparison and a smudge test to prove product efficacy and ease of use, specifically targeting 'straight men' who might be new to makeup.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator explicitly mentions the brand OBgE, shows the products clearly, demonstrates their use, and the video includes brand slogans and a specific spokesperson mention.
